name: Zulfiqar Ahmad Khan
bio: I am a researcher in AI and deep learning, focusing on computer vision, energy forecasting, edge and resource-efficient AI, and federated learning.

I am currently a postdoctoral researcher in the Department of Computing Science at Umeå University, Sweden, through the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP), where I contribute to research projects, co-supervise PhD students, and support research team coordination.

During my PhD at Sejong University, I served as Coordinator of the Intelligent Media Laboratory (IMLab), leading a research team of eight members and contributing to research projects, publications, project proposals, and student supervision.
